items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 cement Anthropic's AI lead just before its IPO
items.summary: Anthropic is releasing Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, its most powerful models to date, in two versions: one freely available and one reserved for verified organizations. The models solve open physics problems, show stronger cybersecurity capabilities, design functioning operating systems, and write more than 90 percent of the changes merged into Anthropic's core code, according to the company....

items.title: Meta launches Muse Ember, a small AI model built for the repetitive work agents actually do
items.summary: Meta is introducing Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient AI model, optimized for repetitive agent tasks such as tool calls, routing, and data extraction. According to Meta, it delivers more intelligence per dollar than Claude Haiku 5.5 or GPT-6 Luna. But it falls short when it comes to actual programming tasks....

items.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics Control, Simulation, and Policy Improvement
items.summary: Google has released Gemini 4 Argon framing it as a general-purpose physical-reasoning model for robot control, Real2Sim scene construction, multimodal labeling of robot video, and iterative policy improvement, rather than as a single end-effector policy. By Daniel Dominguez

items.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
items.summary: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

items.title: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
items.summary: Anthropic says the new models "show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision," as well as in communicating more clearly with users.

items.title: Bytedance's Seedream 5.5 promises pixel-stable image editing across 100 rounds without color drift
items.summary: Bytedance Seed has introduced Seedream 5.5, an image model built for professional production workflows. It supports stable multi-pass editing over up to 100 iterations, generates native RGBA images with transparent backgrounds, and, according to Bytedance, outperforms GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst in realism. A Pro version is planned....

items.title: Tencent's AI chief says AI bioweapons are coming, but closing off models isn't the answer
items.summary: Tencent chief AI scientist Vinces Yao Shunyu warns that AI will soon be able to develop bioweapons and argues for a middle ground between open and closed models. While safety filters on open-source systems can be easily stripped through abliteration, closed models like Anthropic's Claude often block too aggressively....

items.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
items.summary: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

items.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
items.summary: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.

items.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
items.summary: At 10 cents per million input tokens, Ember is significantly cheaper than frontier competitors like Haiku and Luna.

items.title: AWS Launches TorchNeuron to Run PyTorch Models on AWS Trainium Without Modifications
items.summary: At the recent PyTorch Conference North America 2026, Amazon introduced TorchNeuron, a native PyTorch backend that enables developers to run existing PyTorch code on AWS Trainium AI chips with virtually no code modifications. By Sergio De Simone

items.title: A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal
items.summary: Six months before Nvidia's spy scandal erupted, Culper Research was already questioning Jensen Huang's unusually close relationship with a Chinese executive.
